title: Arrival in Sidom
summary: Alma and Amulek depart the city and come to the land of Sidom, where they find the people who had left Ammonihah. An account is related concerning wives, children, those relating it, and their deliverance.

explicit_facts.text: Alma and Amulek were commanded to depart the city, and they came to the land of Sidom.
